registrationTip: Choose whether players pay to register. Paid entry fees are held in escrow by the payment processor and released to the organizer after the event runs.
invalidFileType: Only PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP files are supported.
restrictionsDescription: Control who can register for this event based on their location
requirementsDescription: Block registration until competitors have uploaded the media you need for graphics and broadcasts.
requireTeamLogoDesc: Teams cannot register until their team logo is uploaded.
requireEsportImagesDesc: Every registering player must have their esport image uploaded on their profile.
requireProfileImageDesc: Every registering player must have a profile image uploaded.
requireUidDesc: Every registering player must have their Free Fire UID set on their profile.
requireWhatsappDesc: Every registering player must have a WhatsApp number saved on their profile. Turn this on when you plan to send room details over WhatsApp.
requireLetterAvatarsTip: Teams or players must have at least this many Free Fire letter avatars (A-Z) available before they can register. A team's available letters are the combined letters its members own plus any manual extras added on the team editor.
requireLetterAvatarsDesc: Set the minimum number of letter avatars (1 to 26) competitors must have available to register.
